desc:
🏫 Welcome to Lakeview High School RP!
⚠️ This game is still in early development. ⚠️

Step into a fictional high school roleplay experience where you can take on important school roles, attend classes, explore the campus, and work toward graduation.

Features:
📚 Roleplay as a Principal, Teacher, Parent, Student, or Kid
🧑‍🏫 Teach or attend classes
🎓 Work toward graduation
💎 Earn title rewards
👗 Attend school events and create fun outfits
👮 Help keep the campus safe
🚗 Drive cars and explore the map
🏠 Build your house

We’re excited to share our latest roleplay game with you as we continue adding new features and improvements.

Recent Updates:
Map update + less lag!
More Cars!
Tow Trailers!
Gym Class Archery
APARTMENTS + PENTHOUSE

👑 Join Lakeview Games to get perks and unlock the Vice Principal role for free.
This is a fictional high school roleplay game created by Lakeview Games.
